title: Contrastive Reasoning Alignment: Reinforcement Learning from Hidden Representations
reasoning: The paper focuses on aligning the internal reasoning of Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) to prevent 'unethical reasoning traces'. It specifically evaluates its performance using a 'Safety Evaluation Prompt' that includes criteria for discrimination (based on race, gender, religion, etc.), hate speech, and other harmful/unethical behaviors, directly engaging with the evaluation of moral and ethical alignment in AI.
